proof_summary: The proof constructs an explicit mod-\(10\) closed form whose values, according to the residue of \(n\), are \(0\), \(\pm F_n\), or \(\pm F_{n-1}\). The Fibonacci recurrence shows residue-by-residue that this form satisfies the same fourth-order recurrence and initial conditions, so induction identifies it with the given sequence and absolute values remove the signs.
